_comment: Add these keys to each OriginTrail-hosted node's config.json. `name` MUST be unique per node — it becomes the Grafana Node selector value. `network` is auto-derived by the node (testnet/mainnet) → the Environment label. Requires a node build that includes the OTLP telemetry feature (PR #1317).
_comment_signals: Three independent signals, all OFF until telemetry.enabled=true AND the signal has an endpoint. LOGS use a hand-rolled OTLP/HTTP JSON exporter (the OTel Logs SDK is still 'Development'); set logs.exporter to 'otlp' — if you leave it unset on a hosted node it defaults to legacy syslog/Graylog, NOT OTLP. TRACES and METRICS use the stable OTel SDK exporters (OTLP/protobuf). For the polaris setup today only logs have a backend (Loki via Alloy); keep traces/metrics here so the config is ready when Tempo/Mimir are provisioned, or set traces.enabled/metrics.enabled to false to leave them off explicitly.
name: testnet-core-01
